description: Run this repository's real test, typecheck and lint commands on the current working tree, scan the diff for weakened tests, and write a receipt bound to that exact tree. Call it before you tell the user that work is complete, fixed, passing or ready for review, and paste the result. NOT DONE (done: false) is an answer, not a tool failure: fix the code and call again. Never skip, delete or weaken tests to make it pass. A PASS receipt for an unchanged tree is reused, so calling again is cheap.

base.description: Git ref to diff against for the test-integrity scan. Default: HEAD, i.e. the uncommitted changes.

claim.description: The completion claim you are about to make, quoted; it is recorded in the receipt.

cwd.description: Absolute path of the repository, or of a directory inside it. Default: the client's first workspace root, else the directory the server was started in.

profile.description: full (default) runs every check. lite runs only typecheck and lint and never reports done: true.

strict.description: Also answer NOT DONE when the change weakened tests (high or critical findings), even if the checks pass.

name: isitdone_verify

cached.description: A PASS receipt already proved this exact tree; nothing was re-run.

tail.description: Last lines of the combined output; empty for checks that passed.

done.description: True only when every full check passed on exactly this working tree and no test-integrity finding blocks.

integrity.description: Scan of the change set for weakened tests (deleted tests, new skips, dropped or downgraded assertions, neutered configuration).

blocking.description: Findings that block in strict mode.

noChecks.description: No checks were detected, so nothing was verified.

ok.description: Every check that ran passed. With profile lite this can be true while done is false.

state.description: The receipt this run wrote or reused.

title: isitdone: verify before claiming done
